source_record_claim: Brown-Douglas-Fillmore theory (Chinese source wording: 布朗-道格拉斯-菲尔莫尔理论; source gloss: operator algebras and K-homology).
canonical_statement: Let T and S be bounded essentially normal operators on separable infinite-dimensional complex Hilbert spaces. There is a unitary U between the Hilbert spaces such that U T U* - S is compact if and only if T and S have the same essential spectrum and, for every complex number lambda outside that spectrum, the Fredholm indices of T - lambda I and S - lambda I agree.

canonical_formal_target.planned_signature: For bounded operators T and S on separable infinite-dimensional complex Hilbert spaces: unitary equivalence modulo compact operators iff equality of essential spectra and equality of the Fredholm-index functions on their common complement.

domain_and_universes: Complex Hilbert spaces H and K in Lean universes to be fixed; bounded complex-linear operators T : H ->L[C] H and S : K ->L[C] K; separability and infinite-dimensionality assumptions.
quantifiers: lambda : C outside the common essential spectrum
hypotheses: the self-commutators T*T - T T* and S*S - S S* are compact
conclusion: A unitary intertwines T and S modulo a compact operator exactly when their essential spectra and off-spectrum Fredholm-index functions coincide.
